Home-strained, small batch

Real yogurt.
Actually strained.

Most "Greek" yogurt on shelves is thickened with additives. Ours is strained the old way — hours of draining, nothing added — so it's thick enough to hold its shape in a bowl. That's the "dry" part: less whey, more yogurt.
